title: Exec daily priorities — Sofia Patel
content:
2026-03-03 (Notes / scratchpad)

Top of day — 3 priorities
- Finalize Dedicated pricing proposal for Board review (deliver to CFO + board pack) — need numbers from finance by EOD Thu.
- Decision on launch readiness for v0.9 runtime perf optimizations (latency SLOs) — confirm canary metrics & rollback plan.
- Clear approvals for Private deployment pilot (legal sign-off + KMS requirements) — follow up with Legal.

Weekly goals (exec focal areas)
- Sales + Product: lock Dedicated commercial terms for 2 pilot customers (target close Mar 18).
- Reliability: reduce P99 inference latency by 15% on common LLMs via kernel tuning and batching improvements.
- Compliance: complete SOC readiness checklist for Private offering; three outstanding items assigned.

Meetings / prep (today)
- 09:00 — Exec standup (15m) — agenda: blockers, top risks; prep: ask infra for capacity outlook for Dedicated pilot.
- 10:30 — Deep-dive with Serving Runtime (Evan) — agenda: canary results, perf regressions, KV cache behavior; prep: bring specific example trace (ticket SRT-329).
  Notes to ask: expected 95th/99th improvements after recent kernel change; fallback behavior if batch sizes spike.
- 13:00 — GTM sync with Maya + RevOps — agenda: pricing tiers, free credits plan, sales enablement assets; prep: review draft pricing spreadsheet (attached link).
- 15:00 — Legal — Private deployment security checklist sign-off; prep: list of open items (data residency, KMS integration, audit logs).
- 16:30 — 1:1 with Carlos (Head of Solutions) — agenda: pilot onboarding checklist, PS staffing needs.

Follow-ups / action items (owner — due)
- Finance: provide committed cost model for Dedicated per-GPU and burst pricing (Finance — Alice) — due 2026-03-05.
- Serving Runtime: confirm canary perf window and invisibility criteria for rollouts (Evan) — due 2026-03-04.
- Legal: confirm KMS integration requirements & recommended vendors (Legal — Priya) — due 2026-03-06.
- Marketing: update pilot one-pager and launch timeline (Marketing — Lin) — due 2026-03-10.
- Solutions: finalize onboarding checklist + SOW template for pilot customers (Carlos) — due 2026-03-08.

Risks / signals
- If KV cache edge cases persist, end-to-end latency improvements may not meet SLOs — consider temporary throttling or fallback model variant.
- Sales asks for deeper SLA language for Dedicated; need to quantify tail latency commitments before firm commitments.

Quick reminders / personal notes
- Board pack: include simple chart showing unit cost delta (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + sensitivity to batching assumptions.
- Spend 30m tomorrow on roadmap narrative for Q2; focus on "predictable economics" messaging.
- Inbox: prioritize threads tagged #pilot-legal and #dedicated-pricing.

Decisions needed this week
- Firm pricing tiers for Dedicated (tier structure + burst pricing) — decision by Fri 2026-03-06.
- Whether to expand canary to additional model families before rollout (yes/no) — decision by Thu 2026-03-05 after metrics.

Notes to self (scratch)
- Do not promise specific latency numbers to customers until SRE sign-off.
- Ask Maya for one slide on "cost to latency tradeoffs" for customer calls.
- Follow up with Evan on the perf regression post-kernel-change: sample logs + PR link.

End of day quick wrap (placeholder)
- Completed: reviewed Dedicated pricing draft; left comments on spreadsheet.
- Pending: Finance numbers, legal KMS details, canary perf confirmation.

-- Sofia
